title: Rep. McCormick Warns Against Slowing AI Buildout
title_cn: 众议员麦考密克警告不要放慢人工智能建设速度
summary: Representative Rich McCormick is on Bloomberg This Weekend with David Gura and Christina Ruffini and says the US should continue expanding data centers to support its leadership in artificial intelligence, arguing they can be built responsibly while benefiting local economies. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Data Center Expansion Tests Voter Patience
title_cn: 数据中心扩建考验选民的耐心
summary: The rapid expansion of AI data centers is becoming a political issue in Ohio as residents raise concerns about higher electricity bills, tax incentives and secrecy around local development deals. Representative Greg Landsman joins Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss the issue with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: How Water Scarcity Is Changing the Economics of the Southwest
title_cn: 水资源短缺如何改变西南地区的经济
summary: The Colorado River provides water to seven states, contributing to an estimated $1.4 trillion in annual economic activity. But decades of decline, record-low snowpack and shrinking reservoirs have pushed the system toward crisis, with Lake Powell nearing levels that could threaten hydropower production. As key rules expire and states fail to reach a long-term deal, the federal government is stepping in with proposed cuts to lower-basin water use, hitting Arizona especially hard. Will the Southwest be able to survive on a shrinking Colorado River?  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Canada Digs In as US Trade Fight Escalates
title_cn: 美国贸易战升级，加拿大介入
summary:
Joining Bloomberg This Weekend, Former Canadian Finance Minister Chrystia Freeland says Canada was right to walk away from a trade deal she argues would have harmed both countries, urging Ottawa not to back down and saying past retaliation against US tariffs proved effective. Freeland warns hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that Trump’s approach risks turning allies into “vassals” as Canada prepares dollar-for-dollar counter-tariffs after the US imposed new 50% duties.


(This conversation was edited to omit an incorrect statement about the titles of Canadian government officials.) (Source: Bloomberg)

title: A Teen’s Double Life Reveals London’s Wealth Obsession
title_cn: 一名青少年的双重生活揭示了伦敦对财富的痴迷
summary:
Joining Bloomberg This Weekend is Best Selling Author Patrick Radden Keefe to discuss his new book 'London Falling,' which explores the mysterious 2019 death of 19-year-old Zac Brettler, whose parents discovered after his death that he had been posing as the son of a Russian oligarch. Keefe explains to Christina Ruffini that the story examines London’s influx of extreme wealth and social media-fueled status anxiety while tracing a family’s effort to understand the secret life their son had built.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Alliance Tested as Trump Pulls Out of South Korea Drill
title_cn: 特朗普退出韩国演习，联盟经受考验
summary: The US and South Korea sharply curtailed their annual military exercises after President Donald Trump ordered them scaled back, surprising Seoul as North Korea expands its nuclear and missile capabilities and deepens military ties with Russia. Bloomberg Economics and Senior Geoeconomics Analyst Adam Farrar is on Bloomberg This Weekend with David Gura and Christina Ruffini and explains that move comes as the US shifts an aircraft carrier and other military resources from the Indo-Pacific toward the Middle East, raising questions about Washington’s ability to sustain its security commitments in Asia. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Treasury Buybacks Fail to Calm Bond Market
title_cn: 美国国债回购未能稳定债券市场
summary: The Treasury’s surprise decision to at least double buybacks of longer-dated US debt briefly pushed yields lower, but much of that move quickly reversed as investors questioned whether the intervention can overcome inflation and fiscal concerns. PIMCO Executive VP, Market Strategist and Generalist Portfolio Manger Tony Crescenzi and Host of Bloomberg Money Tom Keene join Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss how markets are now looking to Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole speech for clues on rates and how the central bank will respond to Treasury’s increasingly active role in the bond market. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Iceland Faces Close Vote on EU Talks
title_cn: 冰岛面临欧盟谈判的势均力敌的投票
summary: Iceland will vote August 29th on whether to resume accession talks with the European Union, with recent polling showing a narrow advantage for the “yes” side. RUV Correspondent Ingólfur Bjarni Sigfússon joins Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend and explains that debate is being shaped by security concerns, economic uncertainty and Iceland’s strategic position in the North Atlantic, while opponents warn about sovereignty and control over fisheries. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Harry, Meghan Head Back to Britain After Six Years
title_cn: 六年后哈里和梅根返回英国
summary: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle plan to return to Britain with Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet after six years in the US, with their children set to begin school there in September. Bloomberg News Reporter Tiwa Adebayo explains to David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend that the surprise move brings Harry closer to King Charles as he undergoes cancer treatment, while questions remain over the family’s security and Harry’s strained relationship with Prince William. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bessent Has No Easy Fix for What’s Really Driving Bond Yields Up
title_cn: 对于推动债券收益率上升的真正原因，Bessent 没有简单的解决办法
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent came to office blasting his predecessor for trying to re-engineer the world’s largest bond market. This week he took a stab at it himself.

title: US Push to Isolate Iran Runs Into China
title_cn: 美国孤立伊朗的努力陷入中国
summary: The Trump administration is preparing additional measures to isolate Iran’s economy, but further pressure could mean targeting China, the dominant buyer of Iranian oil. Joining Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss the situation with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini is Bloomberg News Senior Editor Wendy Benjaminson.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: ‘It’s a Carry World’: EM Trade Notches Longest Run Since 2008
title_cn: “这是一个利差世界”：新兴市场交易创 2008 年以来最长记录
summary: Cathy Hepworth, who heads $1.5 trillion asset manager PGIM’s emerging-markets debt team, doesn’t hesitate when asked about her highest-conviction theme across the developing world: “Carry, carry, carry.”

title: Can Canada Still Trust America on Trade?
title_cn: 加拿大在贸易上还能信任美国吗？
summary: Chrystia Freeland says a tentative US-Canada trade agreement may prevent new US tariffs from taking effect, but only if Canada makes major concessions including easing retaliation, allowing US alcohol back into provincial stores and aligning with Washington on some digital issues. Existing US tariffs on Canadian steel, aluminum, cars and auto parts would remain, though at lower levels. Freeland says that would mark a major shift from Canada’s long-held position that such tariffs violate USMCA, and could hurt both countries, especially US manufacturing and the Detroit-Windsor auto supply chain. This interview was recorded on Aug. 20.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Saudi Oil Logistics Roiled Again by Houthis’ Red Sea Threat
title_cn: 沙特石油物流再次受到胡塞武装红海威胁的困扰
summary: Saudi Arabia is yet again being forced to overhaul how its oil gets to customers around the world, as Yemen’s Houthis make it harder for Riyadh to use a backup route that’s been vital to the global economy since the Iran war started.

title: Europe’s Luxury Giants Discern Green Shoots in Key China Market
title_cn: 欧洲奢侈品巨头在中国主要市场看到了新芽
summary: Europe’s biggest luxury firms are turning a little more positive on the crucial Chinese market, as a fragile spending recovery takes shape in the country.

title: F1 Reviews China Boy Band’s Logo for Similarities: Global Times
title_cn: F1审查中国男子乐队标志的相似之处：环球时报
summary: The Formula One group is reviewing and investigating information about a logo used in a concert tour by Chinese boy group Teens in Times, after fans alleged it resembled F1’s trademark, the Global Times reported on Sunday.

title: Mexican Governor Wanted by US Over Cartel Ties Seeks Leave Again

summary: Australia reported its first confirmed case of the H5 bird flu in a mammal, after a long-nosed fur seal was found dead in South Australia.

title: Meta Trial: How Social Media Lawsuits Threaten Big Tech
title_cn: 元审判：社交媒体诉讼如何威胁大型科技公司
summary: A flood of lawsuits against social media giants claim that by engineering their platforms to be hard to resist, the companies are causing serious harm to young users. In the first personal injury case to go to trial, a Los Angeles jury in March found Meta Platforms Inc. and Google negligent in the design and operation of their platforms — awarding $6 million to a 20-year-old woman in a landmark verdict.

title: Alibaba Seeks $10 Billion From Share Sale for AI Expansion

summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. is seeking to raise about HK$80 billion ($10.2 billion) from a share sale, its latest move to compete for global leadership in artificial intelligence.

title: Humanoid Robot Beats Usain Bolt’s 100m World Record in Beijing
title_cn: 人形机器人在北京打破博尔特 1 亿米世界纪录
summary: A humanoid robot ran 100 meters in 9.39 seconds at the opening ceremony of the second World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing, beating Usain Bolt’s world record of 9.58 seconds, Xinhua News Agency reported.

title: DeepSeek Ends Weekend Peak Pricing for API Users From Today
title_cn: DeepSeek 从今天起结束对 API 用户的周末高峰定价
summary: DeepSeek will stop distinguishing between peak and off-peak API pricing on weekends from Aug. 23, with usage on Saturdays and Sundays charged at off-peak rates, the company said in a notice Saturday.

title: Mystery AI Model Ox Alpha Draws Developers With Free Access
title_cn: 神秘AI模型Ox Alpha吸引开发者免费使用
summary: A new artificial intelligence model called Ox Alpha is gaining traction among developers after appearing online for free, even as the identity of its creator remains a mystery.

title: Scenes From the 2026 Beijing World Humanoid Robot Games
title_cn: 2026年北京世界人形机器人运动会场景
summary: The 2026 World Humanoid Robot Games have begun. 666 teams from around the world are competing with more than 2,000 humanoid robots. (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong announced a package of childcare benefits to support families as the city-state grapples with a record-low birth rate and rising concerns over the cost and pressures of raising children.

title: Norway Plans to Keep Ukraine Aid Steady Next Year at $9 Billion
title_cn: 挪威计划明年对乌克兰的援助稳定在 90 亿美元
summary: Norway said it plans to keep its aid to Ukraine at 85 billion kroner ($9.1 billion) in 2027, with the bulk of funding set to go to the war-torn country’s military but the exact breakdown to be made public later.

title: Kazakhstan Votes for New Parliament as Tokayev Hints at Staying
title_cn: 托卡耶夫暗示留在哈萨克斯坦，投票选举新议会
summary: Voters in Kazakhstan are going to the polls to elect a new single-chamber parliament on Sunday, as President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev hinted he may stay in power beyond his current term.

title: Zelenskyy Says Putin Rejected Black Sea Shipping Truce Offer
title_cn: 泽连斯基称普京拒绝了黑海航运休战提议
summary: Ukraine offered Russia a truce on attacks against ships carrying agricultural commodities through the Black Sea, but Moscow rejected the deal because it wanted guarantees against strikes on its energy infrastructure, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.

title: Israeli Settler Siege Highlights ‘Grave’ West Bank Reality
title_cn: 以色列定居者的围困凸显了西岸的“严重”现实
summary: When Loui Ridi hugged his young daughter goodbye at Detroit Metro Airport, she clung to his arm and refused to let go. The 46-year-old businessman said she then asked the question he wanted to avoid: “Are you going to be safe?”

title: Burnham Needs to Avoid Messy UK Budget to Keep Good Vibes Alive
title_cn: 伯纳姆需要避免混乱的英国预算以保持良好的氛围
summary: Andy Burnham has tried to instill positivity into a downbeat British public during his first month as prime minister, with some success. Labour’s fortune in opinion polls has begun to turn around and there are even signs of good vibes reaching the economy.

title: Trump Stock Disclosure Shows More Than 1,000 Trades in June
title_cn: 特朗普股票披露显示 6 月份交易量超过 1,000 笔
summary: President Donald Trump made more than 1,000 securities trades in June, including significant purchases of Berkshire Hathaway Inc., Visa Inc., Mastercard Inc. and Cintas Corp., according to a financial disclosure published Saturday.

title: Canada Demand for Trucks Tariff Relief Imperiled Trade Talks
title_cn: 加拿大对卡车关税减免的需求危及贸易谈判
summary: Trade talks between the US and Canada collapsed Friday in part amid a last-minute standoff over cutting US tariffs on Canadian medium- and heavy-duty vehicles, people familiar with the matter said.

title: GOP Lawmaker Urges Trump to Restore South Korea Military Drills
title_cn: 共和党议员敦促特朗普恢复韩国军事演习
summary: A Republican lawmaker questioned President Donald Trump’s decision to cut short a joint military exercise with South Korea, saying the US should show more allegiance to a longtime Asian ally.

title: Canada Sets US Counter-Tariffs Sept. 8 to Mirror Trump Levy
title_cn: 加拿大将于 9 月 8 日对美国征收反关税，以效仿特朗普征税
summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney said Canada will apply counter-tariffs on $20 billion of US products on Sept. 8, escalating the feud rocking one of the world’s biggest trading relationships.

title: Trump-Aligned Mail Ballot Rules Readied for High Court Decision
title_cn: 与特朗普一致的邮寄选票规则已准备好供高等法院裁决
summary: The US Postal Service finalized a rule that would add extra hurdles to mail-in voting, pressing ahead with one of President Donald Trump’s priorities even as court orders keep the push on hold.

title: Putin Acknowledges Economic Impact From Ukraine’s Refinery Hits
title_cn: 普京承认乌克兰炼油厂遭受袭击对经济造成影响
summary: Vladimir Putin lauded the “heroes” of his military in stepping up a campaign on Ukrainian targets, calling the strikes effective and timely while acknowledging that reciprocal attacks by Ukraine have caused economic damage.
